summary: BioMar Chile is organizing a training course focused on recirculation aquaculture systems technology. The course represents the company's educational initiative in the Chilean aquaculture sector. Salmonexpert (the source) reports this as a straightforward announcement of professional development programming by the regional subsidiary of the BioMar aquaculture feed group. Additional details are not available from the snippet provided, but the article captures that the company is engaging stakeholders through knowledge-sharing on RAS (recirculation aquaculture systems) techniques.
title: BioMar Chile realizará curso sobre sistemas de recirculación
title_en: BioMar Chile realizará curso sobre sistemas de recirculación
